title: Finite groups with quadratic splitting fields for all Cayley graphs
summary: For a graph $Γ$, the splitting field of $Γ$ is defined as the splitting field of the characteristic polynomial of $Γ$ over rationals. The algebraic degree of $Γ$ is defined by the extension degree of its splitting field over rationals. Let $k$ be a positive integer. We call a finite group $G$ \textit{Cayley $k$-integral} if, for every inverse-closed subset $S$ of $G$, the algebraic degree of the Cayley graph $\Cay(G,S)$ does not exceed $k$. We give a complete classification of all finite Cayley $2$-integral groups. It is shown that a finite abelian group is Cayley $2$-integral if and only if it is isomorphic to one of the following forms: $G \cong \mathbb{Z}_2^r \times \mathbb{Z}_5^s$, $\mathbb{Z}_2^r \times \mathbb{Z}_4^s \times \mathbb{Z}_8^t$, or $\mathbb{Z}_2^r \times \mathbb{Z}_3^s \times \mathbb{Z}_{12}^t$, where $r, s, t \geq 0$. Furthermore, we prove that the set of finite non-abelian Cayley $2$-integral groups consists of the infinite family $Q_8 \times \mathbb{Z}_2^n$, with $n \geq 0$, and $22$ specific groups.

AI.tldr: 完整分类了 Cayley 2-integral 有限群（其每个 Cayley graph 的 algebraic degree $\le2$），交换情形与非交换情形均给出。
AI.motivation: 图的 splitting field 与 algebraic degree 刻画其谱的代数复杂度；哪些群的所有 Cayley graph 都低 algebraic degree 是代数图论的自然问题。
AI.method: 对 inverse-closed 生成集分析 Cayley graph 特征多项式的 splitting field，逐类分类。
AI.result: 有限交换群 Cayley 2-integral $\iff$ 同构于 $\mathbb Z_2^r\times\mathbb Z_5^s$、$\mathbb Z_2^r\times\mathbb Z_4^s\times\mathbb Z_8^t$ 或 $\mathbb Z_2^r\times\mathbb Z_3^s\times\mathbb Z_{12}^t$；非交换 Cayley 2-integral 群为 $Q_8\times\mathbb Z_2^n$ 族与 22 个特定群。
AI.conclusion: Cayley 2-integral 群被完全分类，推广了 integral（degree 1）群的研究。
AI.future_work: 分类 Cayley $k$-integral 群（$k\ge3$）；研究 algebraic degree 的分布。

title: On the spectrum and structure of blowup thresholds
summary: The chromatic threshold of Erdős and Simonovits asks when a minimum-degree condition forces every \(H\)-free graph to have bounded chromatic number. Thomassen's homomorphism threshold strengthens this by requiring a bounded \(H\)-free homomorphic image. The recently introduced blowup threshold \(δ_{\mathrm B}(H)\) asks for a still more rigid conclusion: when must every sufficiently dense maximal \(H\)-free graph be an actual blowup of a bounded graph? Thus the blowup threshold measures when quotient-level structure can be upgraded to exact bounded-template structure. We show that, although chromatic and homomorphism thresholds are often hard to separate, the stronger blowup threshold diverges from the chromatic threshold in several fundamental ways. First, we prove that \(δ_{\mathrm B}(H)>0\) for every non-bipartite graph \(H\). Hence, unlike the chromatic threshold, the blowup threshold never vanishes outside the bipartite world. Second, we prove that $δ_{\mathrm B}$ is not monotone under taking induced subgraphs. This shows that the blowup threshold is sensitive to global features of the forbidden graph and cannot be classified by a direct analogue of the monotonicity-based strategy used for chromatic thresholds. Third, we prove that $δ_{\mathrm B}(H)=\frac{1}{4}$ for a natural family of \(3\)-chromatic constrained blowups of odd cycles. This gives a new exact blowup-threshold value beyond the chromatic-threshold spectrum.

AI.tldr: 研究 blowup threshold $\delta_{\mathrm B}(H)$（何时稠密 maximal $H$-free 图必为有界模板的 blowup），证明它与 chromatic threshold 在多个基本方面分离。
AI.motivation: blowup threshold 比 chromatic/homomorphism threshold 更刚性，衡量商级结构何时能提升为精确有界模板结构。
AI.method: 对非二部 $H$、诱导子图单调性与奇圈约束 blowup 分别分析。
AI.result: 每个非二部 $H$ 有 $\delta_{\mathrm B}(H)>0$（不同于 chromatic threshold 可为 0）；$\delta_{\mathrm B}$ 在取诱导子图下非单调；对一族 3-chromatic 约束奇圈 blowup 有 $\delta_{\mathrm B}(H)=1/4$。
AI.conclusion: blowup threshold 对禁止图的全局特征敏感，无法用 chromatic threshold 的单调性策略分类。
AI.future_work: 确定更多 $H$ 的 $\delta_{\mathrm B}$；刻画其可能取值谱。

title: Disproof of the tree product conjecture via the Heisenberg group
summary: Product structure theory aims to understand complex graphs by embedding them into products of simpler graphs. In this direction, Campbell, Distel, Gollin, Harvey, Hendrey, Hickingbotham, Mohar and Wood (2022) put forth the conjecture that all graphs of degree-$d$ polynomial growth (i.e., where balls of radius $r$ have $\mathcal{O}(r^d)$ vertices) can be embedded into the strong product of $d$ trees, each with linear growth, and a constant-size clique. In this paper, we disprove this conjecture for $d = 4$. The counterexamples are finite subgraphs of a Cayley graph of the discrete $3$-dimensional Heisenberg group $\mathbb{H}(\mathbb{Z})$. These graphs were first proposed by Huang and McCarty as potential counterexamples to the conjecture. A key technical tool of our proof is the ''quantitative central collapse'' theorem due to Cheeger, Kleiner and Naor (2011), guaranteeing that every Lipschitz map from the continuous Heisenberg group $\mathbb{H}$ to the function space $L_1$ collapses along a central line.

AI.tldr: 用 Heisenberg 群否证 tree product 猜想：存在 degree-4 多项式增长图不能嵌入 4 棵线性增长树与常数团的 strong product。
AI.motivation: product structure 理论猜想 degree-$d$ 多项式增长图可嵌入 $d$ 棵线性增长树与常数团的 strong product（Campbell 等 2022）。
AI.method: 取离散 3 维 Heisenberg 群 $\mathbb H(\mathbb Z)$ Cayley graph 的有限子图（Huang–McCarty 提出）为反例；关键工具是 Cheeger–Kleiner–Naor 的 quantitative central collapse 定理（Heisenberg 到 $L_1$ 的 Lipschitz 映射沿中心线坍缩）。
AI.result: 对 $d=4$ 否证 tree product 猜想。
AI.conclusion: 多项式增长图的 tree product 猜想在 $d=4$ 失败，Heisenberg 几何是本质障碍。
AI.future_work: 确定猜想成立的最大 $d$；寻找正确的 product 结构刻画。

title: On Ramsey-type problems for paths and cycles with few colour changes
summary: In 1967, Gerencser and Gyárfás determined the exact values of the two-colour Ramsey numbers of paths. In a footnote, they made the following observation: Every $2$-edge-coloured complete graph contains a Hamilton path with at most one colour change. Later, this led to a challenging and still wide open conjecture about covering edge-coloured complete graphs with monochromatic paths. Inspired by the original statement, we study paths and cycles with few colour changes in $3$-edge-coloured complete graphs. For this, we introduce a new Ramsey-type parameter: For $q,k \in \mathbb{N}$ and a graph $G$, let $R_q^k(G)$ denote the smallest $N \in \mathbb{N}$ such that every $q$-edge-coloured complete graph on $N$ vertices contains a copy of $G$ with at most $k$ vertices that are incident to edges in $G$ of different colours. For paths, we show that $R_3^1(P_n) = \frac{3n}{2} + O(1)$, and for even cycles, we show that $R_3^2(C_n) = \frac{3n}{2} + o(n)$.

AI.tldr: 研究 3-边染色完全图中少变色的路与圈，引入参数 $R_q^k(G)$，证明 $R_3^1(P_n)=\tfrac{3n}2+O(1)$、$R_3^2(C_n)=\tfrac{3n}2+o(n)$。
AI.motivation: Gerencsér–Gyárfás 注意到 2 色完全图含至多一次变色的 Hamilton path，启发少变色路/圈的 Ramsey 型问题。
AI.method: 定义 $R_q^k(G)$ 为使每个 $q$-染色 $K_N$ 含至多 $k$ 个变色顶点的 $G$ 拷贝的最小 $N$，并对路与偶圈求值。
AI.conclusion: 3 色下少变色路/圈的 Ramsey 阈值约为 $3n/2$。
AI.future_work: 处理奇圈与更多颜色 $q$；收紧误差项。

title: On Full Brouwer's Laplacian Conjecture
summary: Brouwer's Laplacian conjecture asserts that for any graph $G$ with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges, the sum of the $k$ largest Laplacian eigenvalues satisfies $s_k(G) \le m + \binom{k+1}{2}$ for $k=1, \ldots, n$. The conjecture has been verified for numerous graph classes and for several values of $k$. Recently, Kothari and Tudose (2026) proved the conjecture. In this paper, we prove that equality holds for some $1\le k\le n-1$ if and only if $G$ is a threshold graph with clique number $k+1$, which confirms the full Brouwer conjecture formulated by Li and Guo (2022).

AI.tldr: 刻画 Brouwer Laplacian 猜想的等号情形：$s_k(G)=m+\binom{k+1}2$ 对某 $1\le k\le n-1$ 成立当且仅当 $G$ 是 clique number $k+1$ 的 threshold graph，确认 full Brouwer 猜想。
AI.motivation: Brouwer 猜想（前 $k$ 大 Laplacian 特征值和 $\le m+\binom{k+1}2$）已由 Kothari–Tudose (2026) 证明，其等号情形（Li–Guo 2022 的 full 版本）待定。
AI.method: 分析等号成立的图结构。
AI.result: 等号对某 $1\le k\le n-1$ 成立 $\iff$ $G$ 为 clique number $k+1$ 的 threshold graph，确认 full Brouwer 猜想。
AI.conclusion: Brouwer 界的极值图恰为特定 threshold graph。
AI.future_work: 研究接近等号的稳定性；探索其他谱和不等式的极值。

title: The multilinear forms Cayley graph and the eigenvalue method for tensor codes
summary: The connections between graph theory, and more generally association schemes, and coding theory were established by Delsarte for the Hamming metric and rank-metric codes. The ambient metric space of Hamming-metric codes and rank-metric codes can be seen as Cayley graphs generated by words of weight one. The metrics considered then coincide with the geodesic distances of these distance-regular graphs. We focus on a generalisation of this framework to the space of tensors over a finite field, endowed with the tensor-rank as a metric. This space corresponds to the Cayley graph generated by rank-one tensors, which is not distance-regular for tensors of order at least 3. We show that the spectrum of this graph has a recursive expression and depends on the possible intersections between tensor subspaces of large enough dimension and the Segre variety. The spectrum of this graph for 3-order tensors can be expressed with the rank distribution of the rank-metric codes generated by these tensors. In particular, we obtain the complete spectrum of the graph for 2x3x3 tensors over any finite field. We apply this result to derive bounds on the dimension of tensor codes in the tensor-rank metric using the eigenvalue method, and in particular the ratio-type bound.
comment: 42 pages, 6 tables, preprint of article submitted to SIDMA SIAM

AI.tldr: 研究由 rank-one tensor 生成的 multilinear forms Cayley graph 的谱，用 eigenvalue method 给出 tensor-rank 度量下 tensor code 维数的界。
AI.motivation: Delsarte 用 association scheme 联系编码与图论；tensor 空间（tensor-rank 度量）对应的 Cayley graph 对 3 阶以上非 distance-regular，其谱与编码界此前未知。
AI.method: 证明该图谱有递推表达，依赖大维 tensor 子空间与 Segre variety 的交；3 阶情形用 rank-metric code 的 rank distribution 表达谱。
AI.result: 给出该 Cayley graph 谱的递推，得任意有限域上 $2\times3\times3$ tensor 的完整谱，并用 eigenvalue method（含 ratio-type bound）导出 tensor code 维数界。
AI.conclusion: multilinear forms Cayley graph 的谱结构给出 tensor code 的谱界。
AI.future_work: 计算更高阶/更大尺寸 tensor 的谱；改进 tensor code 界。

title: Improved bounds for the chromatic index of $k$-uniform hypergraphs
summary: In 1997, Alon and Kim conjectured that if $H$ is a $k$-uniform $t$-simple hypergraph with maximum degree $D$ sufficiently large, then the chromatic index $χ'(H)$ is upper bounded by $(t-1+1/t+\varepsilon)D$. Using probabilistic techniques and a nibble coloring method, we prove a general coloring theorem stating that a $k$-uniform $t$-simple hypergraph $H$ with large maximum degree $D$ satisfies $$χ'(H) \le (b+\varepsilon)kD,$$ where $b$ is a particular parameter derived from local structural information about $H$. We use structural techniques to prove sharp upper bounds on $b$ in the 3-uniform 2-simple, and 3-uniform 3-simple cases. In particular, we deduce as a corollary that for sufficiently large $D$, every 3-uniform 2-simple and 3-simple hypergraph of maximum degree at most $D$ has chromatic index at most $2.3581D$ and $2.6791D$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 用概率 nibble 方法改进 $k$-uniform $t$-simple 超图的 chromatic index 界，证明 3-uniform 2-simple/3-simple 超图的 $\chi'$ 分别 $\le2.3581D$、$\le2.6791D$。
AI.method: 概率技术与 nibble coloring 证明一般界 $\chi'(H)\le(b+\varepsilon)kD$（$b$ 由局部结构给出），并用结构方法给出 $b$ 的 sharp 上界。
AI.conclusion: nibble 方法给出改进的 chromatic index 界，向 Alon–Kim 猜想推进。
AI.future_work: 处理更高 uniformity/simplicity；逼近 Alon–Kim 常数。
